subject.title: Feature Request: Batch API support for background tasks

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class delayed provider-turn lifecycle for cost-optimized background agent runs, and which callers should be eligible initially?
rationale: The choice changes a public plugin/provider contract and defines durable session, cancellation, accounting, fallback, and delivery behavior across several product surfaces; source inspection cannot infer that policy safely.

options.title: Design shared delayed turns
options.body: Approve a provider-neutral lifecycle and define persistence, cancellation, accounting, delivery, fallback, and caller eligibility before implementation.

options.title: Start with cron only
options.body: Sponsor a deliberately narrow cron-only contract while explicitly deferring sessions, subagents, and heartbeat integration.

options.title: Keep immediate turns only
options.body: Decline a core delayed-turn lifecycle and leave raw provider batch workflows outside the OpenClaw agent loop.

recommendation.title: Design shared delayed turns
recommendation.body: Approve a provider-neutral lifecycle and define persistence, cancellation, accounting, delivery, fallback, and caller eligibility before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame, central-file contribution history, and the existing review discussion make steipete the strongest available owner for the provider/runtime product boundary.
